flow_m3h.info: The current flow of water through the meter.

max_external_temperature_last_month_c.info: The maximum temperature recorded during previous month.

max_flow_last_month_m3h.info: The maximum flow recorded during the last month.

min_external_temperature_last_month_c.info: The lowest external temperature outside of the meter during the last month.

target_m3.info: The {water} volume recorded at the last billing date.

target_date.info: The target date. Usually the end of the previous billing period.

time_bursting.info: Amount of time the meter has been bursting.

time_dry.info: Amount of time the meter has been dry.

time_flow_above_q4.info: Amount of time the flow was above the Q_4 threshold.

time_leaking.info: Amount of time the meter has been leaking.

time_low_ambient_temperature.info: Amount of time the ambient temperature was too low.

time_reversed.info: Amount of time the meter has been reversed.

flags.BURST: The flow of water has been consistently high for half an hour, which indicates a pipe burst.
flags.DRY: There is no water in the meter. Nothing will be measured.
flags.ERROR: Meter error; details via error reporting. (tpl sts)
flags.FLOW_ABOVE_Q4: The water flow has exceeded the upper flow limit Q4 which can cause too high error rate.
flags.HIGH_AMBIENT_TEMPERATURE: The ambient temperature is above the configured upper temperature limit.
flags.LEAK: The flow of water has not stopped for at least one continuous hour during the last 24 hours.
flags.LOW_AMBIENT_TEMPERATURE: The ambient temperature is below the configured lower temperature limit.
flags.LOW_BATTERY: The battery is running low. Less than 6 months remaining.
flags.NO_CONSUMPTION: No flow of water has occurred for the last 15 days.
flags.REVERSE: The water flows through the meter in the wrong direction.
flags.TAMPER: Attempt of fraud. The meter is no longer valid for billing.
